obs: Cyan, Inc. v. Beaver County Employees Retirement Fund

“To start with, the except clause points to section 77p as a wholenot to paragraph 77p(f )(2). ... As this Court recently explained, Congress often drafts statutes with hierarchical schemessection, subsection, paragraph, and on down the line. ... And [w]hen Congress want[s] to refer only to a particular subsection or paragraph, it sa[ys] so. Ibid.”
"We normally presume that [w]hen Congress want[s] to refer only to a particular subsection or paragraph, it [says] so"
